text: Refines D-0300 and D-0154 for #677: a step whose issue closes while it waits never starts its agent. Admission read the issue once. A step admitted while the issue was open then waited for Codex's turn, sometimes for an hour behind other drafts, and started its agent anyway: #666, closed at 17:24Z on 2026-11-06, had its plan drafted at 17:57Z. Now a step waiting for an agent slot reads its issue again every minute. Once it has a slot and its run is recorded, its agent's wait for its turn reads the issue every minute too, through synth.WhileWanted, and the run reads it once more when its turn comes, just before the agent starts. A closed issue ends the step there. No agent starts, the slot and the turn go to the next step, and the step posts nothing but the close any closed issue gets. The run stays recorded, as one that stopped does, so a reopened issue hears that it stopped, and the recovery protocol needs no new transition. A read that fails leaves the run waiting. Reviews, fallbacks and repairs after an agent started don't check. Built by hand to save Codex credits, as D-0195 allows.
